title: Covering pullbacks exist in the colimit category
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a strict diagram $F:J\to\mathit{Cat}$, and $P_j$ precoverages on its stages. Assume each $P_j$ contains singleton isomorphisms, is stable under finite indexed composition and finite indexed base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and has pullbacks of its covering arrows. Every covering presieve has finite uncurried arrow set. Every transition functor maps covering presieves to covering presieves and preserves the pullback of a covering arrow along any arrow. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] are colimits of sets, and let $Q$ be a precoverage on its vertex. Assume a presieve $R$ on $Y$ belongs to $Q$ exactly when there are a stage $j$, an object $X$, a covering $S$ of $P_j$ on $X$, and an equality $V_j(X)=Y$ such that transport of $S.map(V_j)$ along that equality is $R$. Then every member of every Q-cover has a pullback along every arrow into its target.

proof.text: Unpack a Q-cover using hQ and eliminate its target transport. Eliminate membership in Presieve.map to write its chosen member as the image of an actual member f of a stage cover S. Empty covers require no chosen member and are handled vacuously.

Represent the other arrow g by an arrow b at some stage i using Types.jointly_surjective for the arrow cocone. Its target has the same colimit image as the target X of S. Apply Types.FilteredColimit.isColimit_eq_iff to this equality in the object cocone, obtaining k, a:j to k, c:i to k, and an equality F(a)(X)=F(c)(target b). Define g at k by F(c)(b) followed by eqToHom of the reversed equality. Functoriality of eqToHom, Arrow.arrow_mk_comp_eqToHom, and cocone naturality show that its image has exactly the same Arrow object as g. Cocone naturality similarly identifies the image of F(a)(f) with the original covering member.

The image T of S under F(a) is covering by hcover and contains F(a)(f) by Presieve.map_map. The stage HasPullbacks axiom gives a pullback of F(a)(f) and the lifted g. Every transition out of k preserves it by hpullback applied to T. Apply filteredColimit_preservesPullback to get preservation by V_k, then Mathlib hasPullback_of_preservesPullback to get a pullback of the image cospan.

Transfer this HasPullback along the two Arrow equalities. Arrow.mk_eq_mk_iff identifies sources, the common target, and the arrows up to eqToHom. Substitute the object equalities, simplify the identity transports, and substitute the arrow equalities. This yields the required HasPullback of the original cospan. Assemble the two HasPullbacks structures for all covers and all members.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YL, covering pullback paragraph; endpoint lifting proved with Mathlib set-colimit lemmas, and the existing filteredColimit_preservesPullback supplies preservation.

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_site_covering_axioms_HasPullbacks
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)) :
        Q.HasPullbacks
